title: LOOP WITHOUT FLOOR: recycling sustains producers with no abiotic floor?

identity.note: The probe always ran from the current checkout. A historical arm spec applied here is a settings replay, not a reproduction of its original figure.

preregistration.hypothesis: Owner-ordered floor removal with construction-stock kickstart. If the recycling loop (engaged regen + cyclic) is real, producers persist on 0.01 rain with zero floor; if the floor was the true carrier, they collapse to initial-stock-only dynamics.
preregistration.prediction: prod > 0 on at least 24/36 seeds at tick 6000 (machine criterion). Coexistence NOT predicted.
preregistration.falsification: FALSIFIED if prod > 0 on fewer than 24/36: without the floor the loop does not carry producers — the floor was load-bearing, and any reliance claim must be restated around it, not around decomposers.
preregistration.notPredicted: Consumer/decomposer endpoints, coexistence rates, capture shares (descriptive).
confoundsControlled: Same horizon, engine, lifts, and 14/15 argvRest entries as graze-viability; differences stated, not hidden: (1) nfloor 0.05 -> 0, (2) seeds 18 -> 36 (adds 52001:52018 to match the alone-floor0 panel for the joint reading; rate bar preserved at two-thirds, 24/36 vs 12/18)
Kickstart is the existing construction-laid nutrient stock (no new mechanism); a flatline at bootstrap would motivate an explicit pulse, not assume one
conservation enforced per seed at 0.5%; a seed above it fails the run rather than reporting

criteria.statement: producers > 0 at tick 6000 on at least 24/36 seeds
